none: PAS FindID 989825: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Urbs Roma commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17, possibly Trier mint; abraded. Obverse description: Helmeted bust of Roma left. Obverse inscription: [VRBS ROMA]. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins, two or three stars above. In exergue: possibly [-]MT. Diameter: 15.6mm, Weight: 1.51gms, die axis: 6
